# Sprout Kids Dentistry

> > Sprout Kids Dentistry provides comprehensive pediatric dental care in Quincy and Boston, MA with specialized services including sedation options, preventive treatments, and special needs care for children.

Sprout Kids Dentistry is a pediatric dental practice serving the Greater Boston area with locations in Quincy, MA. Led by Dr. Michelle Anderson and board-certified pediatric dentists, the practice offers a full range of children's dental services from infant oral care through complex restorative procedures, with expertise in treating anxious and special needs patients.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Quincy, MA
- Dr. Michelle Anderson
- Children's dental care

## Core Services

- [Patient Services](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services): Main services page listing all pediatric dental treatments offered by Sprout
- [Routine Check-ups and Cleanings](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/routine-check-ups-and-cleanings): Routine pediatric dental cleanings and preventative check-ups in Quincy
- [New Patient Exams](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/new-patient-exams): New patient exam and dental consultation service for first-time visits
- [Infant Oral Care](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/infant-oral-care): Infant oral care and teething guidance from Dr. Michelle Anderson in Quincy

## Preventive & Restorative Treatments

- [Fluoride Treatment](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/flouride-treatment): Fluoride varnish treatment for cavity prevention and tooth enamel strengthening
- [Protective Sealants](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/protective-sealants): BPA-free protective dental sealants for cavity prevention in children
- [Tooth Colored Fillings](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/tooth-colored-fillings): Composite resin tooth-colored fillings for pediatric cavity treatment in Quincy
- [Silver Fillings](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/silver-fillings): Silver amalgam filling treatment for cavities in children at Sprout Kids Dentistry
- [Pediatric Crowns](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/pediatric-crowns): Stainless steel and tooth-colored crowns for baby teeth restoration
- [Nerve Treatment (Pulpotomy)](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/nerve-treatment-pulpotomy): Pulpotomy nerve treatment as root canal alternative for baby teeth decay
- [Dental Extractions](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/extractions): Pediatric tooth extraction and post-extraction care with space maintainers
- [Space Maintainers](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/space-maintainers): Space maintainers for preserving room for permanent teeth after extractions
- [Dental X-Rays](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/radiographs-x-rays): Digital dental X-rays and radiographs for cavity detection in pediatric patients

## Sedation & Anxiety Management

- [Laughing Gas (Nitrous Oxide)](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/laughing-gas-nitrous-oxide): Nitrous oxide sedation service for anxious children at Sprout Kids Dentistry
- [In-Office Sleep Dentistry](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/in-office-sleep-dentistry): IV sedation sleep dentistry service for anxious pediatric patients in Quincy
- [Hospital Dentistry under General Anesthesia](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/services/hospital-denistry-under-general-anesthesia): Hospital dentistry under general anesthesia service at Franciscan Children's Hospital

## Special Care & Emergencies

- [Special Needs Patients](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/pediatric-dentistry-2/specials-needs-patients): Specialized dental care for autism, sensory sensitivity, and developmental delays
- [Dental Emergency](https://www.sproutkidsdentistry.com/pediatric-dentistry-2/dental-emergency): Emergency dental care and after-hours services for urgent pediatric cases
